objective: Compress Plan, Review, Run, and Trace so consultants see answer-first guidance in under 30 seconds while preserving W92 state authority.
compressionDecisions: Live Question is no longer injected around the default tab render path.
Story Bar is no longer injected around the default tab render path.
Plan keeps setup intake visible only when setup is incomplete; ready-state evidence moves behind an audit disclosure.
Review makes DCC handoff export the first card and moves detailed write/status/evidence packet review behind an audit disclosure.
Run keeps the script first and collapses controls, move detail, guardrails, and coaching under audit detail.
Trace keeps export, checklist, and reset controls only; pilot result import is no longer part of the normal pilot evidence surface.
visualRegressionChecklist: Only one IDB drawer root should be visible after opening the drawer.
Plan first viewport should show a single 30-second plan card and no duplicate Story Bar.
Review first viewport should show DCC handoff export and no long packet audit before the export button.
Run first viewport should show Say, Show, and Close before controls or guardrails.

bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W94: Visual QA And Duplicate Drawer Cleanup
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W94: Visual QA And Duplicate Drawer Cleanup. Use the W93 compressed UI to run a visual and state smoke focused on duplicate drawer roots/buttons, drawer width and positioning, first-viewport readability, Plan/Review/Run/Trace screenshots, Tampermonkey duplicate install detection, and one active IDB root guarantee. Fix any layout or duplicate-render defects without changing W92 state authority or DCC handoff boundaries. Preserve no IDB writes, no SuiteScript invocation, no transaction writes, hosted resolver optional until remoteSmokeExecuted=true, notes story-only, consultant confirmation required, and DCC ownership of object generation. Output visual QA results, duplicate-root guard if needed, screenshots checklist, validator gates, W94 report, and best next Codex prompt.
